question: Import taste-skill (Leonxlnx/taste-skill)
choice: Import v2.1.5 commit 12af471f to .agent/skills/design-taste-frontend and global config
rationale: MIT license, passed security audit, provides anti-slop frontend art direction rules and inspection tools

question: Select 100% free cloud deployment topology for GoCar Auto
choice: Cloudflare Pages (SPAs) + Render.com Docker (Backend API) + TiDB Cloud Serverless (MySQL DB) + Cloudflare R2 (10GB Object Storage) + cron-job.org (Cold-start ping)
rationale: Zero ongoing cost (bash.00/mo), eliminates cold starts via 10-min keep-alive ping, no credit card required for TiDB, zero bandwidth overage fees on Cloudflare Pages, full native compatibility with Express and React Vite frontends

question: Define mandatory software engineering and deployment lifecycle workflow
choice: Strict 3-Stage Tiered Lifecycle: 1. Local Antigravity Development & Verification (Localhost) -> 2. GitHub Version Control & Automated CI -> 3. Live Production Edge (Cloudflare Pages + Render + TiDB Cloud)
rationale: Guarantees zero regressions, zero untested code reaching production, full traceability of changes in Git, and automated CI gate enforcement before live deployment.

question: Which design system toolkit to use for redesigning the customer portal
rationale: Adopted pbakaus/impeccable (Apache 2.0) for design vocabulary, anti-slop rules, critique, and precision UI craft across the customer portal

question: Migrate Edge Frontends from Cloudflare Pages to Vercel
options: Stay on Cloudflare Pages with custom domain
choice: Migrate both customer portal and staff interface to Vercel Edge Network (https://gocarauto.vercel.app & https://gocarauto-3kpg.vercel.app)
rationale: Cloudflare Pages Anycast IP routing (188.114.97.x) encounters regional ISP blackholing in Egypt causing connection timeouts. Vercel routes reliably across Egyptian ISPs with zero downtime and clean SPA rewrite support.

question: Framework and architecture for full-application mobile and tablet responsiveness
rationale: Impeccable adapt engine specifies exact mobile/tablet heuristics (thumbs-first bottom navigation, table-to-card adaptive views, touch target >= 44px, bottom sheets instead of centered modals) without adding external dependency bloat or breaking zero-error bundle targets.
